name: Express.js to Fastify Migration Pack
trustedExecutionNote: Packs execute shell commands (typecheckCmd, testCmd, routeSnapshotCmd). Only load trusted packs.
knownLimitations: AST route extraction matches receiver identifiers named app, router, fastify, or server. Full prefixed route verification relies on the runtime routeSnapshotCmd.

detectionRules.description: Express response methods: res.json(), res.send(), res.status(), res.sendStatus()
Express router creation or mounting: express.Router(), Router(), app.use()

agentGuidance.MIGRATE: Convert Express imports, routers, and handlers to Fastify (`FastifyPluginAsync`, `request`, `reply.code(c).send(d)`). Name the plugin instance parameter `fastify` so route invariants can be extracted. Do NOT include any `// @shift-shim` comments.
agentGuidance.SHIM: This module has unmigrated upstream callers (`pendingCallersCount > 0`). Write a dual-compatible shim so untouched Express callers still compile and pass tests. For response helpers, check `typeof reply.code === 'function'`. For middleware/hooks, declare `(req: any, reply: any, ...legacyRest: any[])` so `fn.length === 2` for Fastify while calling `legacyRest[0]?.()` for Express. For routers, export BOTH a Fastify plugin (param named `fastify`) and the legacy Express router under its original export name. Tag ONLY the legacy fallback lines with `// @shift-shim`.
agentGuidance.DE_SHIM: All upstream callers of this module are now fully migrated (`pendingCallersCount == 0`). Remove all Express fallback branches and remove all `// @shift-shim` comments so the module uses pure Fastify types.

invariants.description: Every (HTTP_METHOD, PATH) registered on app/router/fastify/server in this file must match baseline_sets.
